section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: When the pointer idles at the edge of the screen a message is sent to all tasks. At present this message relies on the iconbar toggle being enabled. Future versions may not have this restriction.

message-definition.name: ScreenEdgeNotification
message-definition.description: The pointer has idled over the edge of the screen

message-table.message:
Bit mask:
Left of screen Bottom of screen Right of screen Top of screen

use.p: This message is sent by the WindowManager when the pointer idles over the edge of the screen. It is intended that shortcut applications might use this to activate themselves.
